 Big Picture
 6 die of dengue, 1,866 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 445 as total cases reach 1,42,775 
 Published : 4 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 4 November 2026, 19:12
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least six dengue patients died and 1,866 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, four were reported in Dhaka division and two in Khulna division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities, the death toll from the mosquito-borne disease rose to 445, while the cumulative number of cases reached 1,42,775.
 Currently, 5,936 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
